newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALMET, SWEDISH UTEC SET WOOD DRYING J/V.
newsitem.headline: VALMET, SWEDISH UTEC SET WOOD DRYING J/V.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Valmet Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it would combine its wood drying equipment business with Swedish Utec sm AB's and set up a joint venture Valmet-Utec Oy to run the operation from Turku.
It did not give the volume of the operation.
A Valmet official said Valmet's wood drying equipment operation's net sales has varied between 20 million and 40 million markka and that the joint venture would aim above that.

Utec has a strong market position in wood drying equipment in Scandinavia and exports to the U.K., Russia and the Baltic states while Valmet has a strong position in Finland, Sweden and Russia, the statement said.
